somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.title: Somethings Addons Config
Somethings Addons Config
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.protectC: Prevents players in Creative mode from being instantly killed by the /kill command gating bypass.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.applyDmg: Limits the maximum amount of damage an entity can take from a single hit.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.hpToAppl: Entities must have this much Max HP or more for Damage Gating to apply.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.maxDamag: Maximum percentage of Max HP that can be lost in a single hit (0.1 = 10%).
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.applyHea: Limits how fast entities can heal per second.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.maxHealP: Maximum percentage of Max HP that can be healed per second (0.05 = 5%).
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.applyBos: Grants extreme knockback resistance to entities with high Max HP.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.hpToAppl: Entities must have this much Max HP or more to be completely immune to knockback.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.globalBe: Prevents ANY modded boss or entity from breaking Bedrock or Wither-immune blocks.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.enableCu: Enables the custom list of protected blocks below.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.protecte: List of block IDs (e.g., minecraft:chest) that cannot be broken by bosses.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.enableDa: Enables the enhanced stats, armor piercing, and phase mechanics for the Wither.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.witherNo: Prevents items from dropping when the Wither breaks blocks to significantly reduce lag.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.witherBa: Maximum health of the Wither when spawned.
Armor points of the Wither during Phase 1.
Melee attack damage of the Wither during Phase 1.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.witherPh: The Wither enters Phase 2 when its health drops below this value.
Armor points of the Wither during Phase 2.
Melee attack damage of the Wither during Phase 2.
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.witherAr: Percentage of the target's armor ignored by all Wither attacks during Phase 2 (0.3 = 30%).
somethingsaddons.midnightconfig.witherSk: Base damage dealt when a Wither Skull directly hits a target.
Radius and damage scale of the Wither Skull explosion (Vanilla is 1.0).
